effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
payment_terms: Gross receipts will be used first to pay business expenses, then to maintain a 10% reserve, and then monthly payouts will be made to the parties according to the agreed ownership split. Any cash advanced to the venture is treated as a loan first unless the parties sign a written ownership change. No spending above $500 may be incurred without both parties’ approval.
purpose: Services relationship: operative commitments below follow your notes. The parties are starting and running a mobile coffee cart together. party_a paid for the trailer and machines, and those items stay party_a’s personal property unless the parties sign a written transfer. party_b will run the daily operations of the cart. The business ownership split is 60/40. Spending above $500 requires approval from both parties before the expense is made. Future cash put into the venture is treated as a loan first unless the parties later agree in writing to convert it into ownership. If either party wants to exit or transfer their interest, the other party gets the first right to buy at fair market value, with value determined using the trailing 6 months earnings or an independent appraisal. The parties want a clear dispute path that starts with mediation and, if needed, moves to binding arbitration. The arrangement should also cover monthly payout timing after expenses and after keeping a 10% reserve.
